status: FROZEN at the commit that first adds this file. Made before any validation experiment exists (runs/s_valid holds 0 products) and before any F2 assembly, in response to the independent review of 2026-09-25 (review worktree at d16a1198; findings 1-9 accepted). No gate is loosened after a result: the corrections below either withdraw an overclaim or ADD evidence requirements.

R1_seed_gate_withdrawn.finding: HIGH: contract G-seed-5pct counted the 5% projected-sigma gate as met because F2's seed is inert; plan section 6 (and clarification 4) says identical outputs from an unused seed establish reproducibility only.
R1_seed_gate_withdrawn.correction: G-seed-5pct is WITHDRAWN as a stability pass. For a seedless deterministic estimator the plan's 5% seed-movement gate has no seed ensemble to test and is recorded as NOT APPLICABLE; it is never reported as passed. Amendment 1's phrase 'seed stability ... G-seed/G-perm evidence' is withdrawn with it.
R1_seed_gate_withdrawn.replacement_evidence_G_stab_F2: estimator sensitivity is measured instead on the ARMS: one unfold of each arm type is re-run with its MC and data rows in a seeded random order (s5c_with_estimator.py --permute-seed 1) and compared bin by bin with the construction's own product: real-data bootstrap replica 1 (npz path), vertical universe Flux:0 (bank path), unified-throw slab 0 (4 unfolds, bank path), ML split 1 (npz path), detector universe GEANT_Pion:0 (driver path), lateral endpoint BeamAngleX_0 (driver path, selection-complete). Gate: for every compared product, max over the central value's positive cells of |x_perm - x_ref| / |x_ref| <= 1e-6. Scope stated: this establishes insensitivity to row order for each code path, which bounds order-induced movement of every block; it does not establish insensitivity to choices F2 fixes by definition (thread count 32, full-sample binning) and, per clarification 4, it cannot replace coverage evidence.
R1_seed_gate_withdrawn.G_perm_wording: contract G-perm tests the central unfold only; its phrase 'cannot move any projected sigma by more than that' is withdrawn; G-stab-F2 is what reaches the arms.

R2_sample_sizes.finding: MEDIUM: the contract note and the feasibility receipt quoted sample sizes from the m = 129 rows while stating m = 459.
R2_sample_sizes.correction: at m = 459 (exact CP, Bonferroni assurance lower bound, forward scan; docs/orchestration/state/s5c/samplesize-m459.json): 80% assurance needs 21,152 experiments per grid point if 68% coverage is exactly nominal, 6,716 if 0.70, 2,935 if 0.72; for the 95% gate 11,711 if exactly nominal, 5,828 if 0.96, 3,530 if 0.965. At the contract's n = 4,000: assurance lower bounds 0.9985 (68%, true 0.72) and 0.9589 (95%, true 0.965); 0 at exactly nominal. The frozen n = 4,000 is unchanged.

R3_S_PASS_scope.finding: MEDIUM: S_PASS said 'the F2 statistical intervals are coverage-validated', more than Tier S tests.
R3_S_PASS_scope.correction: S_PASS establishes only: for the F2 estimator unfolding with one MC half (weights x2), intervals f_hat +- sigma and +- 1.96 sigma with sigma FIXED from one development bootstrap (200 replicas) meet the gate on the 153 functionals over the three truths at nominal nuisance. Stated limits that travel with any S_PASS: (a) the reported real-data intervals use a full-MC unfold and sigma from the real data's own 100-replica bootstrap -- the transfer is an argument (same procedure, MC statistics doubled), not validated; (b) sigma's own estimation noise (about 5% relative with 200 replicas) is not propagated; (c) the bootstrap, like production's bootstrap_nd.py, resamples event weights but does not redraw the background or rebuild purity weights, while each validation experiment does; (d) coverage of total (statistical + systematic) intervals is not tested (Tier T).

corrections.R6_inference_wording: the feasibility receipt's 'more than the envelope's total' is CPU-only (38,720 x 0.0104 = 403 > 345.27 CPU node-h); counting the GPU pool the envelope could hold about 39,000 experiments before Tier S and the reserve, still fewer than one comparison's null ensemble plus size validation plus Tier S. The plan's insufficient-precision exit (report the Monte Carlo interval with a precision limitation) would not qualify a comparison under section 9 condition 4. The disposition is unchanged.
corrections.R7_seed_streams: bootstrap replica b uses default_rng(b), the same stream family that drew development experiment 1's pseudo-data (seed 1); validation seeds 200000-211999 are disjoint, so validation independence is unaffected. Recorded, not changed.
corrections.R8_F1_definition: F1's failure uses pairwise movement relative to the k=0 member, |sigma_k - sigma_0| / sigma_0, as GRADE-20260920 defines s_proj; under that definition a maximum over more seed pairs can only grow.
